summary.text: Eric Schmitt was sworn in on January 3, 2023, and is serving his first term as a U.S. Senator from Missouri.

paragraphs.text: He previously served as Missouri Attorney General and as the state's 46th State Treasurer, and was twice elected to represent Missouri's 15th Senate District.
He grew up in Bridgeton, Missouri, graduated from Truman State University, and received his J.D. from Saint Louis University.
